title: RTO and RPO Timeline
description: An interactive SVG timeline anchoring RPO (the data-loss window before an incident) and RTO (the downtime window after it) to a single incident marker, with hover tooltips and worked tier examples.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Distinguish the Recovery Point Objective from the Recovery Time Objective.
State which direction in time each objective measures relative to the incident.
Read an example RPO/RTO pair for a given system tier.

instructionalStrategies: Have students point to which side of the incident is RPO and which is RTO before revealing tooltips.
Give a system and have students propose and justify an RPO/RTO pair from the cost of data loss versus downtime.

assessmentQuestions.question: A team sets RPO to 5 minutes but RTO to 24 hours. What does that imply about backups versus failover?
Why is RPO = 0 effectively impossible, and what does chasing it cost?
